method: Answers are extracted only where the retained source text addresses the narrow question. Missing answers do not inherit a broad stance. Compatible economic priorities are not classified as conflict.

questions.label: Haredi draft: men who leave yeshiva
questions.question: Require service from young Haredi men who have left yeshiva?
questions.note: Shas and UTJ differ on men who have left yeshiva. Universal military-or-civilian service proposals also cover this group; the same answer here does not establish agreement about continuing students.

questions.label: Haredi draft: service exemptions
questions.question: Allow exemptions in a military-or-civilian service framework?
questions.note: Yashar specifies up to 3% of each annual national cohort; Blue and White proposes quotas and outstanding-individual exceptions without the same quantified limit. A general commitment to service for all does not establish the exemption mechanism.

questions.label: Courts: judicial appointments
questions.question: Repeal the 2025 judicial appointments law?
questions.note: Likud's answer is a March 2025 legislative record, not a new campaign response. Repealing the same law does not establish agreement on its replacement.

questions.label: Courts: legislative override
questions.question: Should the Knesset be able to reenact a law struck down by the Supreme Court?
questions.note: The thresholds are substantive differences. Constitutional codification alone supplies no answer on an override.

questions.label: Courts: reasonableness review
questions.question: Narrow the reasonableness standard while retaining it?
questions.note: Opposing abolition in a 2023 vote does not necessarily answer a proposal to narrow the standard in 2026.

questions.label: Religion and state: civil marriage
questions.question: Allow a civil marriage option inside Israel?
questions.note: Some answers are secondary summaries. An older component-party platform is not a current commitment by its entire joint list.

questions.label: Religion and state: Shabbat transport
questions.question: Allow public transport on Shabbat through local choice?

stances.label: Allow local choice / a limited service

questions.note: Bennett's transport statement is from April 20, 2026, before the B'Yachad joint list. The displayed answer records that leader statement, not an adopted joint-list platform.

questions.label: Religion and state: conversion
questions.question: Recognize conversion beyond the Orthodox religious establishment?
questions.note: Civil marriage support does not imply a view about conversion.
